title: Deeper/broader scratch ACIS producer and open-source route-lineage refresh
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Screen newly surfaced open-source producer and application routes for DWG/DXF/ACIS evidence
Separate implementation, parser, writer, kernel, application and test-input lineage
Reconcile current ACadSharp and LibreDWG issue horizons against existing local owners
Refine the optional ACIS scratch-producer gate without promoting support claims

method.kind: Read-only review of project READMEs, current issue indexes, project route descriptions, and the local parity plan
method.limitations: Project README and issue pages are mutable and maintainer-reported. No immutable obj2cad revision/artifact was bound; its fetched ACadRust source and patch were not inspected; no route was built or run. The separate scalar-curve implementation progress already present in the worktree is recorded in its own implementation receipt.

sources.revision: Mutable main README reviewed 2026-10-18; no immutable source/artifact pair bound
sources.observed: The README describes a pre-release OBJ-to-DXF/DWG converter with an ACIS SAT/SAB writer and an acis-samples command for plane, box, cylinder, cone, sphere and torus bodies. It says DWG and curved-surface output are beta pending AutoCAD acceptance; the DWG writer is fetched from a patched ACadRust route. The README claims independent input/readback parity and ACIS readback through ezdxf/ACadRust, but those claims were not executed here.

obj2cad's documented build route fetches a patched ACadRust writer, so its DWG writing is not an independent DWG codec lineage. ACadRust's own advertised coverage matrix does not itself establish per-entity interoperability or native acceptance.

The reviewed descriptions route cadze DWG ingestion through LibreDWG and dwg2png through ACadRust. These are downstream application/render routes, not additional independent parser lineages; the dwg2png real-file success counts were not independently run or bound to a semantic manifest.

sources.revision: Mutable issue indexes and current NEWS reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The visible reports cover version-specific MTEXT whole-file rejection, SPLINE projection, recursive DXF input, EED size handling, nested-block copy cost, DWG-to-DXF ownership/framing, ACDSDATA loss, parser safety, and output integrity. Cross-check against the current plan found existing owner mappings; this source-only review did not confirm an additional local defect.

assessment.planImpact: Adds obj2cad as an optional, exact-pinned scratch ACIS producer candidate at the existing PAR-07/S8 composed checkpoint; keeps its patched-ACadRust DWG writer and pre-release claims below independent parser/kernel/native evidence. Reconciles newly surfaced application routes under their existing parser lineage and retains the current issue-to-owner ledger. No implementation or validation-order change.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep obj2cad off the per-slice path; first pin source, artifact, build/runtime, and the exact fetched/patched ACadRust revision.
If selected, generate scratch analytic bodies only and retain an independent source expectation manifest instead of trusting project parity hashes or same-family round trips.
Separate raw DXF modeler payload or DWG AcDs owner-key association, typed parse disposition, analytic geometry checks, and native strict-open/AUDIT outcome.
If any identity or evidence lane cannot be bound, mark the candidate NOT_RUN and continue local work.
Do not change fast-test frequency or full-suite cadence; preserve local-generated-only fixture policy and keep all six J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
